author: bshastry
content:
Yes. Quoting my llm

> 0x87b69a306c8e430d0857f7c4ac5e27cecffa1108d43c2e5df7388056fea7a423
> 
>   That is the SSZ root of an ExecutionRequests object whose request lists are empty—it is not the all-zero hash.
> 
>   Why: Buildoor first constructs an ordinary payload with no deposits, withdrawals, consolidations, builder deposits, or builder exits. The attack transformation changes only:
> 
>   bid.block_hash = bid.parent_block_hash
> 
>   and then re-signs the bid. It deliberately preserves the genuine empty-requests commitment.
